about: Choices made by the data for Denning's cap_test and pair_test corrections (model.py cap_test): held-out log loss with no cap and with each option, and with the tested pairs allowed or blocked; a change is kept only if it beats the alternative by 0.0005.

spike_killable_diff.verdict: no cap (no option beat it on unseen matches)

pairs.verdict: allowed (blocking didn't predict unseen matches better)
